facts.claim: User file ~/.vibe/hooks.toml, array of [[hooks]] with name, type (pre_tool|post_tool|post_agent), command, match? (fnmatch glob or re: regex, case-insensitive), timeout seconds default 60, strict default false, description?
Fail-closed switch: strict = true; pre_tool failures (spawn error, timeout, non-zero exit, invalid JSON, non-object) become a deny
Stdin: session_id, transcript_path, cwd, parent_session_id, hook_event_name, tool_name (qualified), tool_call_id, tool_input (author-facing names)
Deny is JSON on exit 0: decision deny + reason; reason becomes the tool error the model sees; first deny short-circuits
Any non-deny decision, including absent or unknown, continues to the normal permission prompt; allow does not pre-approve; no ask value
Exit 2 has no special meaning; any non-zero exit is a hook failure (allow by default, deny under strict)
Input rewrite: hook_specific_output.tool_input, full replacement, re-validated against schema

Names: tool_name qualified, e.g. file_system.bash, process.start, mcp_<server>.<tool>, connector_<alias>.<tool>; match also tests underscore form and bare leaf; background commands go through process_start, not bash
Nothing in pre_tool ends the run
Hook protocols vibe, claude_code, kimi_code exist (for plugin hooks); hooks.toml uses the vibe protocol
